@st.composite
def gen(draw):
    n = draw(st.integers(1, 12))
    s = draw(st.text(alphabet="abc", min_size=n, max_size=n))
    return s + "\n"


def edge_cases():

        "aabbcc\n",
        "abcabc\n",
        "abcba\n",
        "cccccc\n",
        "cbacba\n",
        "ababab\n",
        "aaaaaaaaaa\n",
        "abcabcabcabc\n",
        "acbbcaacbab\n",
    ]


def validate(inp):
    if not inp.endswith("\n"):
        return False
    s = inp[:-1]
    if "\n" in s or "\r" in s:
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(s) <= 3 * 10**5):
        return False
    return all(ch in "abc" for ch in s)


def ref(inp):
    s = inp.strip()
    n = len(s)
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            ok = True
            for k in range(i, j):
                if s[k] == s[k + 1]:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                count += 1
    return str(count % MOD) + "\n"

from hypothesis import strategies as st

MOD = 998244353


@st.composite
def gen(draw):
    n = draw(st.integers(1, 12))
    mode = draw(st.integers(0, 2))
    if mode == 0:
        s = draw(st.text(alphabet="abc", min_size=n, max_size=n))
    elif mode == 1:
        # long runs of equal characters to stress adjacency
        chars = []
        while len(chars) < n:
            c = draw(st.sampled_from("abc"))
            k = draw(st.integers(1, 4))
            chars.extend([c] * k)
        s = "".join(chars[:n])
    else:
        # alternating-ish patterns
        a, b = draw(st.sampled_from(["ab", "bc", "ca", "aa", "abc"]))[:2] if False else ("a", "b")
        start = draw(st.sampled_from("abc"))
        order = "abc"
        idx = order.index(start)
        s = "".join(order[(idx + k) % 3] if draw(st.booleans()) else order[(idx + k) % 3]
                    for k in range(n))
    return s + "\n"


def edge_cases():
    return [
        "a\n",
        "b\n",
        "aa\n",
        "ab\n",
        "aaa\n",
        "abc\n",

        "abcaabbcc\n",
        "bcbcbcbcbc\n",
        "aaaaaaaaaaaa\n",
        "abcabcabcabcabc\n",
        "aabbaabbaabb\n",
    ]


def validate(inp):
    tokens = inp.split()
    if len(tokens) != 1:
        return False
    s = tokens[0]
    if not (1 <= len(s) <= 3 * 10**5):
        return False
    return all(ch in "abc" for ch in s)


def ref(inp):
    s = inp.split()[0]
    n = len(s)
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        count += 1
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if s[j] == s[j - 1]:
                break
            count += 1
    return str(count % MOD)
